page.title: Advanced Assets
page.description: Model option Greeks and chains, listed real-estate income, private-market performance, and futures margin risk in one workspace.
page.warning: Sample positions, peers, fund metrics, and cash flows are scenarios—not connected holdings or live market data. Calculations are analytical aids, not investment, tax, legal, or trading advice. No advanced-asset trades are written to the Core ledger.
page.footer: Extension-first models · Decimal.js precision 40 · THB/contract conventions shown inline

options.deskSubtitle: European option valuation, first-order Greeks, and expiry payoff scenarios.
options.sampleRowsNotice: Sample rows only. Greeks shown are illustrative snapshots, not live market quotes.
options.unitsNotice: Theta and vega units depend on the quote convention; confirm the contract multiplier before trading.
options.modelCaveat: Black–Scholes assumes European exercise and no dividends. American exercise, dividends, rates, and market microstructure can materially change fair value.
options.dialogDescription: Enter annualized rates and time to expiry in years. Results are computed by the authenticated Decimal.js pricing API.

chain.title: Options chain
chain.subtitle: Black–Scholes bid/ask scenarios, volatility, and deltas across three expiries.
chain.selectedStrike: Selected strike {strike} · {type} · premium uses the model ask · contract multiplier {multiplier}
chain.quoteCaveat: Quotes are scenario model outputs from the Options Desk assumptions, not exchange quotes, recommendations, or executable prices. Confirm contract size, exercise style, and market data before trading.
chain.payoffDialogDescription: Long-option expiry payoff using the selected model ask and a 100-share contract multiplier. Values are illustrative, before fees and taxes.
chain.decimalChartNote: Net payoff is calculated in Decimal.js before chart conversion.
chain.refreshFallback: The dated sample chain remains visible; sign in to refresh the model.

reits.incomeSubtitle: Listed real-estate exposure, distribution cadence, and unit-level valuation signals.
reits.navNotice: NAV and yield figures are scenario inputs for demonstrating the analytics surface; verify against fund reports before use.
reits.estimateNotice: Estimates are illustrative; actual distributions are declared by the fund manager.
reits.distributionNavProxy: Distribution / NAV proxy: {value}. This is not a property-level capitalization rate.
reits.valuationDialogDescription: Use unit-level reported NAV, annualized distribution, and FFO inputs. Cap-rate output is a distribution-to-NAV proxy, not a property cap rate.
reits.affoNote: AFFO subtracts maintenance capex per unit. Use fund-reported capex when disclosed; otherwise a 10% FFO proxy is shown by the engine.
reits.comparisonSubtitle: Compare distribution income, trading premium/discount, and sample occupancy assumptions.
reits.peerAssumptions: All peer metrics are sample assumptions, not verified market data.
reits.addPeer: Add a peer to populate the chart.
reits.chartNumberNote: Chart values are converted to numbers only for rendering; yields are calculated with Decimal.js.
reits.comparisonDisclaimer: Illustrative educational dataset only. Yield and Price/NAV are calculated from the sample inputs shown in this workspace. SIRI is an illustrative residential peer and must not be assumed to be a REIT. Verify fund classification, distributions, occupancy, and market capitalization with issuer filings before investment decisions.

pe.dashboardSubtitle: Capital deployment, return multiples, and dated-cash-flow performance.
pe.xirrCashflowNote: XIRR example cash flows include capital calls, distributions, and a terminal residual realization in the final dated point.
pe.multipleNote: Multiples are capital-weighted scenario figures; unrealized values can change and are not liquidity guarantees.
pe.screenerSubtitle: Screen illustrative venture, growth, and buyout funds by vintage and performance ranges.
pe.noFundsMatch: No sample funds match these criteria. Adjust the ranges to continue.
pe.fundDisclaimer: Fund names are sample references; performance, cash flows, and AUM are entirely illustrative and are not actual fund disclosures. IRR uses dated cash flows and Decimal.js at precision 40 in the companion engine. No live fund data is connected.
pe.fundDetailDescription: {vintage} vintage · {stage} · scenario J-curve and dated cash flows
pe.filterErrorFallback: Review the filter ranges and try again.
pe.filterErrorIrrNegative: IRR percentage bounds cannot be negative.
pe.filterErrorIrrRange: Minimum IRR cannot exceed maximum IRR.
pe.filterErrorTvpiRange: Minimum TVPI cannot exceed maximum TVPI.
pe.filterErrorVintage: Vintage year range must be a valid ascending integer range.
pe.filterErrorFinite: Enter valid finite decimal filter values.

futures.title: Futures risk monitor
futures.subtitle: Account-level equity, maintenance margin, mark-to-market P/L, and estimated liquidation level.
futures.lowBuffer: Low margin buffer · immediate review advised
futures.marginWarning: Scenario margin level is {level}%. Check broker-specific rules, maintenance rates, and liquidation procedures; this estimate is not a broker alert.
futures.riskThresholds: Risk thresholds: <100% margin call · 100–120% danger · 120–200% warning · ≥200% healthy.
futures.linearEstimate: Linear estimate assumes per-contract margin and no fees, funding, slippage, cross-collateral, or broker-specific liquidation buffers. Maintenance amounts scale with contract count.
futures.liquidationDistance: Current distance from entry to estimated liquidation: {points} points.
